description: This file defines the data structures and function prototypes for managing a routing tree used in pub/sub messaging, supporting multiple routes per topic, wildcards, and TR-069 style expressions. It includes classes for routes and topics, and functions for creating, destroying, adding, removing, querying, and logging routing information.

classes.name: rtTreeRoute
classes.description: Represents a route with a list of directly assigned topics.

classes.name: rtTreeTopic
classes.description: Represents a topic node in the routing tree, with parent, children, and associated routes.

classes.name: _rtRoutingTree
classes.description: Main routing tree structure containing the root topic and list of all routes.

methods.name: rtRoutingTree_Destroy
methods.description: Deallocates and cleans up the routing tree.

methods.name: rtRoutingTree_AddTopicRoute
methods.description: Adds a route to a specific topic in the routing tree.

methods.name: rtRoutingTree_GetTopicRoutes
methods.description: Retrieves all routes associated with a given topic.

methods.name: rtRoutingTree_GetRouteTopics
methods.description: Retrieves all topics associated with a given route.

methods.name: rtRoutingTree_RemoveRoute
methods.description: Removes a route from the routing tree.

methods.name: rtRoutingTree_RemoveTopic
methods.description: Removes a topic and its associated routes from the tree.

methods.name: rtRoutingTree_ResolvePartialPath
methods.description: Resolves a partial path to a list of topics, supporting wildcards and instance IDs.

methods.name: rtRoutingTree_LogStats
methods.description: Logs statistics about the routing tree.

methods.name: rtRoutingTree_LogTopicTree
methods.description: Logs the structure of the topic tree.

methods.name: rtRoutingTree_LogRouteList
methods.description: Logs all routes in the routing tree.
